# Scorecard Research
> Scorecard Research provides digital audience measurement, market research, and online behavior analytics through panel and census-based methodologies.

Scorecard Research is associated with audience measurement and research services used to understand web and digital media usage. Publicly accessible site content is limited, so this file emphasizes the main public pages and policy-related resources available on the domain.

## Main
- [Home](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/): Overview of Scorecard Research and its audience measurement research presence.
- [Welcome](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/): Landing page introducing the Scorecard Research website.

## Privacy & Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/privacy.aspx): Explains data collection, usage, and privacy practices for Scorecard Research services.
- [Opt Out](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/optout.aspx): Lets users opt out of Scorecard Research measurement and related data collection.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/terms.aspx): Describes terms governing use of the Scorecard Research website and services.
- [Contact](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/contact.aspx): Provides contact information for inquiries related to Scorecard Research.

## Research Information
- [About Scorecard Research](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/): General information about the organization and its measurement activities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/privacy.aspx): Details the research data practices and privacy protections applied on the site.
- [Opt Out](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/optout.aspx): Consumer-facing controls for participation in measurement and analytics collection.

## User Controls
- [Opt Out](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/optout.aspx): Main user choice page for disabling Scorecard Research tracking technologies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/privacy.aspx): Reference for understanding available privacy choices and data handling.
- [Contact](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/contact.aspx): Support channel for privacy, participation, or website-related questions.

## Legal
- [Terms of Use](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/terms.aspx): Legal terms covering access to and use of the Scorecard Research website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scorecardresearch.com/privacy.aspx): Legal and operational disclosures about personal data and measurement practices.

## Support
